verdict.rationale: Persistent custom instructions are a fair axis for a chat assistant like Grok, but the evidence pack never documents a custom-instructions, persona, or saved-preferences feature that shapes every response. The closest items are general settings syncing across platforms and server-side storage of prompts. Both are adjacent features, not user-defined instructions applied to every response.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can set persistent custom instructions and preferences that shape every response
